sources.title: FireRedASR: Open-Source Industrial-Grade - GitHub
sources.snippet: FireRedASR is a family of open-source industrial-grade automatic speech recognition (ASR) models supporting Mandarin, Chinese dialects and English, achieving a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) on public Mandarin ASR benchmarks, while also offering outstanding singing lyrics recognition capability.
